label: New session options
note: The web's New session page draws the options on the form itself, so it has no second row for them.

label: Start a session that can edit files
note: The web's New session form carries the file-access choice, so it needs no verb of its own.

label: End or remove session
note: One dialog in the terminal client both ends and removes; the web splits removal out into session.delete, so its row is the narrower one and says so.

label: Delete this session
note: The terminal client reaches removal through session.end's dialog rather than from a row of its own.

label: Hand this session's work to a fresh one

web.label: Hand off to a new session

note: Two wordings for one verb; S1 moved both into this file without moving either screen, and converging them is a change to one of them.

label: Send the draft
note: The terminal client sends with Enter and lists no row for the key it is already showing.

label: Queue the draft
note: Same Enter in the terminal client: whether it sends or queues is the turn's state, not a second row.

label: Retry the last message
note: interactive.retry_turn has no terminal-client verb yet.

label: Edit prompt in $EDITOR
note: $EDITOR is a terminal's; a browser has no editor to hand the draft to.

label: Reasoning effort for the next turn
note: The terminal client's row names the scope and the web's names the control; converging them is a screen change S1 did not make.

label: Plan without editing anything
note: One row named for the posture and one for the mode, and S1 recorded both rather than moving either screen.

label: Change file access (OS sandbox)
note: docs/TUI.md quotes the terminal client's wording of this row, so converging the pair belongs to a slice that can edit that page.

label: Auto-approve everything this session asks
note: Two wordings for one toggle; S1 recorded both rather than moving either screen.

label: Answer the pending approval
note: The terminal client reaches the waiting request by ctrl+x a and has no typed spelling for it.

label: Run a command in the workspace
note: The terminal client sends a draft that begins with ! to workspace.exec without carrying a palette row for it.

label: Toggle event details
note: The terminal client toggles the detail level over the whole transcript; the web opens one event's tree, so neither label fits both.

label: Show changed files
note: The web has no view of a session's changed files yet.

label: Toggle raw copy mode
note: A native terminal selection needs cells with no frame or gutter; the browser copies with a button instead.

label: Copy last agent message
note: tui/tests/onboarding.rs pins the terminal client's wording, so converging the pair is a change to that test as well as to the screen.

label: Copy last agent message as source Markdown
note: The terminal client's dispatcher spells the argument raw; the web's palette shows source. Only one of them parses a draft, so the spellings have not been merged.

label: Load earlier messages
note: The terminal client holds the whole transcript and scrolls it, so there is nothing to fetch.

label: Export the transcript to a file
note: Two wordings for one verb, and S1 changed neither screen.

label: Print transcript into terminal scrollback
note: Scrollback is a terminal's; the web downloads the transcript through conversation.export instead.

label: Open transcript in $EDITOR
note: $EDITOR is a terminal's.

label: Go back to an earlier message
Compact this conversation now
note: Two wordings for one verb, and S1 changed neither screen.

label: Show what fills the context window
note: The terminal client's row says what the overlay shows and the web's names the panel; converging them is a screen change.

label: Show tokens and cost for this session
note: The web reports spend in the vitals column rather than as a verb.

label: Runtime & distribution
note: The terminal client's Dashboard tab and the web's /status page are the same subject on two differently shaped surfaces, and each is named after the thing it opens.

label: Audit
note: The terminal client has no audit view yet.

label: Show this node's MCP servers
note: The terminal client names the node whose servers it lists; the web's panel is titled for the servers themselves.

label: Logs
note: The web has no logs page yet.

label: Connect ChatGPT
note: The web connects an account from its Settings page rather than from the palette.

note: A web upgrades page is deferred in the parity plan.

note: Workspace capability proposals have no web surface yet.

note: Workspace capability proposals have no web surface yet.

note: Workspace capability proposals have no web surface yet.

label: Change the colour theme
note: docs/TUI.md quotes the terminal client's wording and deck_live_test.exs asserts the web's, so converging the pair moves both.

label: Show the effective key map
note: The terminal client's keys are rebindable, so its row names the map in force; the web's keys are not, so /keys there is the one sheet it has.

label: Keyboard shortcuts
note: The terminal client's ? opens a second, static sheet; on the web ? opens the sheet client.shortcuts names, so there is one row there and two here.

label: Notify me when a session needs me
note: The terminal client's notification preferences live in Settings rather than as a verb.

label: Quit
note: A browser tab is closed by the browser.
